<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/graphs/{id}/nodes/{nodeId}/neighbours"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the nodes and edges reachable from the specified node in one hop (undirected). Results are passed through the configured GraphReadFilter.
